import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 505;
    static int n, m, mod;
    static int[][] C = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static long[] f = new long[maxn], g = new long[maxn];
    static long[][] F = new long[maxn][maxn], G = new long[maxn][maxn];

    static int add_mod(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x + y;
        if (sum >= mod) sum -= mod;
        return sum;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int x, int y) {
        return (int)((long) x * y % mod);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        // Compute binomial coefficients
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = add_mod(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        // Initialize f and g
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                int termA = mul_mod(mul_mod((int)f[j - 1], (int)f[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                f[i] = add_mod((int)f[i], termA);
                int termB = mul_mod(mul_mod((int)f[j - 1], (int)g[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add_mod((int)g[i], termB);
                int termC = mul_mod(mul_mod((int)g[j - 1], (int)f[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add_mod((int)g[i], termC);
                int termD = mul_mod(mul_mod((int)f[j - 1], (int)f[i - j]), mul(add_mod(C[j][2], C[i - j + 1][2]), C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add_mod((int)g[i], termD);
            }
        }

        // Initialize F and G
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                F[i][j] = 0;
                G[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        F[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            F[i][i] = f[i];
            G[i][i] = g[i];
            int limit = Math.min(i - 1, m);
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l <= j; l++) {
                    long tempF = mul_mod((int)f[l], (int)F[i - l - 1][j - l]);
                    long tempG = mul_mod((int)g[l], (int)F[i - l - 1][j - l]);
                    long tempF2 = mul_mod((int)f[l], (int)G[i - l - 1][j - l]);
                    long comb = C[j][l];

                    G[i][j] = add_mod((int)G[i][j], (int)mul_mod((int)tempG, (int)comb));
                    F[i][j] = add_mod((int)F[i][j], (int)mul_mod((int)tempF, (int)comb));
                    G[i][j] = add_mod((int)G[i][j], (int)mul_mod((int)tempF2, (int)comb));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(G[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
